resources.string: Limits the actual video frame rate. The head unit, connection or phone temperature may lower it further. Applies on the next connection.
Aligns audio with video in CarLife and Android Auto. Turn off to remove the additional synchronization delay; sound may then precede the picture. Applies on the next connection.
Audio/video synchronization is off. The saved delay correction will apply after synchronization is enabled.
Use Android screen timeout and lock

HSD does not keep the phone screen awake: Android controls screen timeout and locking. On some Android versions, head unit touches also extend this timeout. Manual panel blanking remains a separate action and does not lock the phone.
Open HSD to complete or restore activation. USB will start in the background when access is ready.
Open HSD to allow USB access.
